Scheduled emails run in the background and can't personalize per recipient, so the same rows go to everyone on the subscription. To prevent leaking row-level data, delivery is refused unless an admin has checked Broadcast Safe on the report or dashboard.

If a subscription's Last Status reads Failed — not Broadcast Safe, open the report/dashboard record and tick Broadcast Safe once you've confirmed its contents are appropriate for every recipient.
Why a report must be "Broadcast Safe"
